author: single independent author
mode_limit: Ledger transfers are declared background completed records tested at written certificate/mark sites; this program does not physically perform Journal-to-Ledger posting. Marking is a separate written Journal act.
constants: role1:first role in explicitly written ordered frame
role2:second distinct role in that frame

primitives.effect: Written binder explicitly introduces one transaction and two distinct ordered roles. No entry, mark, completion, amount, calendar value, counterresult or entire episode is supplied by the frame.

Read the specified role from the actual frame and test a preexisting completed Ledger record for that transaction/role/date/value. Missing or mismatched record gives MISSING/CONTRADICTION, not an invented posting. The word asserts/certifies a supplied entry; background existence is a separate paid assumption.
Retain actual certificate, role, transaction and Journal as the input to marking.

Same operation at both local daiin applications. Recheck actual entry/certificate dependency; record that side completed transfer in Journal and return a distinct mark object with transaction/owner. Never creates a Ledger entry.
Project owner and transaction from the selected actual retained mark object. Every lexical FIRST/LAST license is paid; no global A/B substitution. Missing selected output blocks.

Same reciprocal operation at both dar applications. Use the explicitly written two-role frame; retain source owner/mark origin/T and return its distinct opposite account role. No hidden address map, self-account, generated role or universal d prefix.
Collect both distinct actual returned inputs in written order without rebuilding them.

primitives.signature: Frame,actual CounterResult,retained actual JournalMark outputs -> MarkRead
primitives.effect: Read the mark whose owner is exactly the returned role, retaining transaction and the actual mark-object ID/value. Missing owner/transaction or missing mark yields a visible barrier; never reads a global DONE value or hardcoded role.
State/test the specified source dependency, mark availability or owner/transaction consistency using actual returned values; no economic settlement inference.
Return that very contained object unchanged, with provenance; selectors are explicit costs rather than raw position exceptions.
Terminal conditional assertion of its actual content; redundancy is retained, not claimed new evidence.

primitives.signature: actual earlier typed return,explicit fixed reference policy -> that return
primitives.effect: Retain object identity under a priced selector. No free recreated-role lookup or carry over unknown raw intervals.

reference_policy: Select actual prior returns by finite type and written order; exact whole selectors and scope/collection rules are declared in EXTENSIONS before first complete derivation. Explicit source IDs document resulting dataflow, never choose per-occurrence semantic exceptions.
syntax_policy: One paid local prefix COUNTER application construction may delay lexicalized whole dar until its written right operand returns a RoleSelection. Collection/project grammar is finite and explicit. No universal immediate-host or prefix semantics.
whole_policy: The two required local daiin uses share MARK_POSTED. dar is one context-bound lexicalized whole COUNTER operator; atomic fixed605 representation is preserved. All extra exact-whole values, aliases, selector defaults and any proposed part licenses must be frozen separately before first completed derivation. No whole token encodes the complete two-mark/two-counter/read episode.
background_costs: One declared preexisting Ledger record per role, each with T/date/value and its distinct account identity. These are hypothetical external world inputs, not observed manuscript/historical transactions.
Written ENTRY_CERT assertions are charged separately from background entry existence.
Opaque T/ordered roles/J/L/V/D are introduced only by actual written FRAME construction, not simulator initialization.
unknown_policy: UNKNOWN raw or unresolved interval remains a barrier; no silent carry, entity normalization or alternate-word alias. Literal words may retain fixed diagnoses after first block, with later operations unexecuted.
counterfactual_policy: Missing background entry must fail the actual ENTRY_CERT or dependent MARK site; changing a retained mark must affect only its dependent owner-read; wrong counter/T must propagate or fail; consistent role1/role2 global renaming remains equivalent.
claim_ceiling: Conditional local C0 only; no physical Ledger posting execution, confirmed lexemes, historical source identification, likelihood, reserve use or independent confirmation.
